name: Cambridge-style C1 Advanced (Writing)
description: Four criteria scored 0-5 with C1 expectations, modelled on the public structure of the C1 Advanced writing assessment.

criteria.name: Content
criteria.description: All content is relevant, the target reader is fully informed, and points are developed and supported rather than just listed.

criteria.name: Communicative Achievement
criteria.description: Uses the conventions of the task type effectively to hold the reader's attention and communicate complex ideas; register and tone are consistently appropriate and purposeful.

criteria.name: Organisation
criteria.description: Text is well organised and coherent, using a variety of cohesive devices and organisational patterns to generally good effect.

criteria.name: Language
criteria.description: Uses a range of vocabulary, including less common lexis, effectively and precisely; uses a wide range of simple and complex grammar with full control, flexibility and sophistication; errors are rare slips.
